title: Governance Method, Experiment, Adoption, and Implementation Authority Interface Specification
non_authority_clause: Schema conformance, cryptographic validation, tool approval, or software capability does not establish lawful authority.
canonical_doctrine: Methods structure how authority is exercised. They do not create the authority.

authority_effect_labels.description: Educational, expressive, simulated, or descriptive; creates no procedural or legal effect.
Offers analysis or recommendations; the competent authority must respond only where another rule requires it.
Structures participation or records a process; does not decide the substantive issue.
May be considered as evidence for a stated purpose; does not establish liability, consent, or authority.
Records a valid holder's decision within its exact scope; does not create jurisdiction or waive others' rights.
Points to an independently valid authority record; does not itself grant the power.
A decision by a competent authority under an exact legal source; cannot be produced by a tool or method merely by schema conformance.
Starts an already authorized action and its clocks.
Carries out a separately authorized operation within defined limits.
Terminates power, returns authority and assets, disposes data, and preserves unresolved duties.

action_classes.name: Sense and observation
action_classes.description: Signals, observations, complaints, opportunities, alerts, and preliminary claims.

action_classes.name: Validation and jurisdictional triage
action_classes.description: Provenance checks, uncertainty, severity review, affected-party mapping, routing, and referral.

action_classes.name: Proposal and alternative formation
action_classes.description: Candidate responses, objectives, alternatives, reversibility, resources, and expected effects.

action_classes.name: Method selection and deliberation
action_classes.description: Choice and adaptation of deliberative, epistemic, ethical, cultural, technical, or facilitation methods.

action_classes.name: Affected-party authority, consent, refusal, and representation
action_classes.description: Who is affected, who may decide, who must consent, who may refuse, and who may represent whom.

action_classes.name: Authority verification and protected-domain classification
action_classes.description: Legal source, jurisdiction, exact power, limits, activation state, and domains that cannot be ordinary experiments.

action_classes.name: Trial authorization and adoption registration
action_classes.description: Lawful permission to run a bounded trial and the record that an adoption has been claimed or accepted.

action_classes.name: Operational activation and implementation
action_classes.description: The distinct act that begins operations, assigns operators, releases resources, and starts clocks.

action_classes.name: Monitoring, evidence, review, and challenge
action_classes.description: Baselines, metrics, observations, causal assessment, complaints, interim relief, and corrections.

action_classes.name: Amendment, pause, suspension, rollback, renewal, and scaling
action_classes.description: Change control without silent expansion, including new-jurisdiction authorization.

action_classes.name: Expiry, termination, closure, remedy, and authority return
action_classes.description: Ending power, restoring prior arrangements, preserving duties, disposing data, and compensating harm.

action_classes.name: Readiness, ethics, epistemic, and institutional assessment
action_classes.description: Advisory assessments that expose risk and missing conditions without becoming hidden vetoes.

action_classes.name: Facilitators, auditors, assessors, catalyst teams, and technical services
action_classes.description: Qualifications, mandates, conflicts, complaints, liability, and non-monopoly rules.

action_classes.name: Funding, procurement, participation support, and incentives
action_classes.description: Financial authority, independent support, conditions, contracts, essential continuity, and appeals.

action_classes.name: Institutional regeneration, charter change, and dissolution
action_classes.description: Mandate review, governance redesign, staff and beneficiary continuity, succession, and unresolved duties.

action_classes.name: Data, identity, automation, publication, archives, and tool stewardship
action_classes.description: Identity versus office, protected data, AI limits, versioning, forks, failure libraries, and deletion.

action_classes.name: Emergency, urgent, and coercive handoffs
action_classes.description: CDEE/ECRC referrals, protected-domain exception routes, SCPA execution, and domain-specific interfaces.

action_classes.name: Non-activation, sandboxing, conformance, and interoperability
action_classes.description: Fail-closed pilots, authority-effect labels, handoff acceptance, compatibility, and release controls.

protected_domains: detention, arrest, restraint, policing, intelligence, search, seizure, force, weapons, border action, sanctions, and surveillance
migration status, asylum, deportation, confinement, or mobility restrictions
essential water, sanitation, food, shelter, healthcare, disability support, education, communication, or basic income
child protection, guardianship, substitute decision-making, or dependent-person care
title, tenure, rematriation, eviction, asset seizure, receivership, or permanent land/resource allocation
irreversible ecological intervention, species release, geoengineering, high-impact extraction, or destruction of protected habitat
high-risk AI, cyber operations, biotechnology, synthetic biology, nanotechnology, autonomous weapons, or containment
criminal, civil, administrative, or constitutional adjudication and evidence
emergency declaration, command, compulsory evacuation, rationing, or continuity powers
taxation, compulsory levy, funding freeze, benefit withdrawal, debt cancellation, or asset forfeiture

records.title: Constituting Instrument, Legal Source, Jurisdiction, and Activation Status
records.purpose: Identifies the presently valid source of authority for a consequential governance action.
required_content: competent authority and office holder or body
territorial, personal, subject-matter, and temporal jurisdiction
activation, ratification, delegation, and suspension status
review, expiry, amendment, and revocation route
conflicts with other law or authority
prohibited_inferences: A framework reference, policy goal, software token, vote, consensus, urgency, funding condition, or pilot success cannot substitute for this record.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before trial authorization, activation, institutional change, funding condition, emergency action, or coercive handoff.

records.title: Method, Tool, Protocol, Template, and Authority-Effect Classification
records.purpose: Classifies an implementation instrument by what it can and cannot legally do.
required_content: tool or method identity and version
prohibited_inferences: A template does not create a council, office, court, consent, charter, benefit, emergency power, or enforcement authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Must accompany every tool stack, resource card, method recommendation, and software module.

records.title: Actor, Agent, Office, Representation, and Technical Capability Record
records.purpose: Distinguishes identity, technical access, organizational role, public office, representation, and fiduciary standing.
required_content: human, body, community, organization, AI, sensor, or service role
prohibited_inferences: A DID, UCAN, API key, signature, organizational title, community label, or facilitator certificate does not establish public office or authority to represent others.
records.lifecycle_relation: Links every action to a responsible actor and separately valid authority.

records.title: Sense Signal, Complaint, Opportunity, and Asserted Scope Record
records.purpose: Preserves what an agent reports without treating the report as verified fact.
prohibited_inferences: Severity, urgency, jurisdiction, causation, affected-party identity, and legal violation remain asserted until separately validated.
records.lifecycle_relation: May be created by any permitted agent; cannot directly activate a consequential action.

records.title: Observation, Evidence, Provenance, and Protected-Source Record
records.purpose: Records observations and supporting material with provenance, uncertainty, consent, and access controls.
required_content: hashes or locators without exposing protected payloads
prohibited_inferences: Cryptographic integrity proves that bytes are unchanged, not that the observation is true, lawful, representative, or admissible.
records.lifecycle_relation: Supports validation, assessment, investigation, or monitoring.

records.title: Signal Validation, Corroboration, and Status Record
records.purpose: Classifies a signal as unreviewed, partially corroborated, validated for a stated purpose, disputed, false, or unresolved.
prohibited_inferences: Validation for routing does not establish legal breach, emergency, liability, or authority to act.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before any consequential routing that relies on severity, urgency, or identity.

records.title: Severity, Urgency, Reversibility, and Uncertainty Assessment
records.purpose: Separates the seriousness and time sensitivity of a problem from the power available to address it.
required_content: time horizon and rate of change
prohibited_inferences: High severity or immediate urgency cannot create jurisdiction, emergency status, coercive power, or automatic priority over rights.
records.lifecycle_relation: May inform routing, review clocks, and precautionary recommendations.

records.title: Jurisdictional Triage, Competent-Authority Referral, and Acceptance
records.purpose: Routes a validated matter to a potentially competent authority without transferring power by silence.
required_content: acceptance, rejection, or request for clarification
prohibited_inferences: Referral, receipt, notification, or silence does not create acceptance or transfer authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Must reach explicit acceptance before the recipient acts under the referral.

records.title: Affected Persons, Communities, Nations, Outsiders, and Transboundary Effects Map
records.purpose: Identifies who bears benefits, burdens, risks, data exposure, exclusion, or irreversible effects.
required_content: residents, users, workers, tenants, migrants, minorities, and dissenters
future and non-human interests where applicable
notice, participation, support, and remedy needs
prohibited_inferences: A majority, host institution, platform, geographic label, or community leadership cannot erase internal minorities or affected outsiders.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before consent, trial authorization, scaling, or institutional redesign.

records.title: Affected Indigenous Nation, Applicable Indigenous Law, and Protected-Knowledge Authority
records.purpose: Records the specific affected nation or nations and their own authority, law, representatives, and knowledge controls.
required_content: applicable Indigenous law and consent route
prohibited_inferences: A global Indigenous representative, retired framework, external elder, quota, facilitator, or advisory council cannot consent or speak for an affected nation.
records.lifecycle_relation: Controls affected-nation participation and protected knowledge across the lifecycle.

records.title: Notice, Accessibility, Independent Advice, and Participation Support
records.purpose: Ensures that participation is informed, accessible, materially possible, and not dependent on adopting the proposed method.
required_content: accessible, offline, oral, assisted, and disability formats
independent legal, technical, cultural, or financial advice
care, transport, connectivity, income, and safety support
prohibited_inferences: Lack of digital access, literacy, identity documents, money, certified facilitators, or agreement with GGF methods cannot reduce standing.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for consequential consent, deliberation, review, and remedy.

records.title: Proposal Intake, Source Signal, Sponsor, and Status Record
records.purpose: Records a proposed response without implying endorsement or authority.
prohibited_inferences: A proposal, algorithmic recommendation, community petition, facilitator recommendation, or council agenda item is not consent or authorization.
records.lifecycle_relation: Opens proposal development and deliberation.

records.title: Proposal Objective, Alternatives, Rights Effects, and Reversibility Record
records.purpose: Makes the substantive choice and its alternatives reviewable before method or authority decisions.
prohibited_inferences: A good objective or reversible design does not supply authority; a low-cost pilot can still violate rights.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before deliberation and trial authorization.

records.title: Method Selection, Cultural Adaptation, Autonomy Statement, and Authority Effect
records.purpose: Records why a deliberative, assessment, technical, or implementation method was chosen and how it was adapted.
prohibited_inferences: Cultural adaptation cannot classify a community from outside, essentialize identity, or authorize acts beyond the adopting authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Links selected methods to their bounded purpose.

records.title: Deliberation Plan, Facilitation Mandate, Record, Dissent, and Reasons
records.purpose: Defines how a proposal will be deliberated and how facilitation remains subordinate to the lawful decision body.
required_content: agenda, speaking, accessibility, and safety rules
prohibited_inferences: Facilitators, ethics panels, epistemic assessors, algorithms, or ceremonies cannot replace the decision authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Produces a reasoned deliberative record, not authorization by itself.

records.title: Epistemic Readiness, Provenance, Disinformation, and Trust Assessment
records.purpose: Provides an advisory account of whether the information environment can support a decision.
required_content: uncertainty, dissent, recommended repairs, and non-veto status
prohibited_inferences: A threshold, score, certification failure, or remediation recommendation cannot suspend a lawful decision or create an emergency exception.
records.lifecycle_relation: The competent decision body records how it responds to the assessment.

records.title: Ethics, Harm, Rights, and Anti-Capture Advisory Review
records.purpose: Surfaces ethical risks, rights impacts, capture, conflicts, and missing safeguards without becoming hidden approval power.
prohibited_inferences: An ethics gate, MOS alignment, Indigenous-framework representative, or certified reviewer cannot create or withhold legal authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Must be answered with reasons where the governing charter requires review.

records.title: Consent Requirement, Holder, Scope, and Dependency Map
records.purpose: Determines which forms of consent, authorization, consultation, notice, assent, or collective decision are actually required.
required_content: individual, collective, fiduciary, parental, worker, member, or affected-nation form
prohibited_inferences: Consent cannot create jurisdiction over third parties or waive non-derogable rights; one consent holder cannot waive another's rights.
records.lifecycle_relation: Precedes collection of consent and trial authorization.

records.title: Consent, Refusal, Withdrawal, and Non-Retaliation Record
records.purpose: Records a decision by a valid holder without reducing it to a free-text field.
prohibited_inferences: Silence, attendance, use of a service, receipt of support, technical signature, or absence of objection is not consent unless valid law expressly establishes it with safeguards.
records.lifecycle_relation: Must remain linked to the exact proposal and may require renewal.

records.title: Authority Verification, Decision Class, and Protected-Domain Classification
records.purpose: Confirms whether the proposed action is within ordinary experimentation or requires a specialized constitutional route.
prohibited_inferences: Method simplicity, local popularity, reversibility, urgency, or expected benefit cannot downgrade a protected domain.
records.lifecycle_relation: Fail-closed gate before trial authorization.

records.title: Trial Authorization, Conditions, Scope, and Non-Precedent Record
records.purpose: Authorizes a bounded experiment without converting it into permanent policy or broader precedent.
prohibited_inferences: A trial authorization does not authorize coercive execution, expansion to nonparticipants, new jurisdictions, permanent enactment, or use outside its conditions.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for consequential experiments.

records.title: Adoption Claim, Deliberative Acceptance, and Registration Record
records.purpose: Records that an entity claims to adopt or accept a proposal and states the legal meaning of that claim.
prohibited_inferences: An `adopt()` event without complete authority references means only that adoption was claimed; it is not binding or active.
records.lifecycle_relation: May precede or follow trial authorization depending on local law, but cannot replace it.

records.title: Operational Activation, Start Conditions, Operator, and Clock Record
records.purpose: Distinctly starts an authorized action and begins its legal, operational, review, and expiry clocks.
required_content: review, expiry, stop, and rollback clocks
prohibited_inferences: Authorization, registration, smart-contract creation, software deployment, or funding approval does not equal activation unless this record is valid.
records.lifecycle_relation: Makes the action operational.

records.title: Implementation Plan, Responsibilities, Dependencies, and Service Boundaries
records.purpose: Translates authorization into accountable tasks without expanding scope.
prohibited_inferences: An implementer cannot reinterpret broad goals as new powers or treat operational convenience as amendment.
records.lifecycle_relation: Controls day-to-day implementation.

records.title: Non-Derogable Rights, Essential Services, Safety, and Continuing Duties Record
records.purpose: Protects rights and duties that cannot be experimented away or allowed to expire by default.
required_content: essential water, food, shelter, health, income, disability, education, safety, and communication duties
prohibited_inferences: A sunset, funding withdrawal, failed metric, community vote, or operator exit cannot terminate continuing duties.
records.lifecycle_relation: Must be linked to every trial or institutional transition that could affect protected interests.

records.title: Funding Authority, Participation Support, Independence, and Non-Conformity Record
records.purpose: Separates lawful funding from pressure to accept a method, ideology, institutional redesign, or data exposure.
required_content: participation support independent of substantive agreement
prohibited_inferences: A readiness score, ethics alignment, module count, public reputation, or method adoption cannot automatically create, deny, freeze, or claw back funding.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before money or material support becomes consequential.

records.title: Procurement, Contract, Vendor, Platform, and Technical-Service Record
records.purpose: Makes private and technical implementation relationships visible and bounded.
prohibited_inferences: A vendor, platform, smart contract, cloud service, or algorithm cannot become the decision authority or withhold public records and services through lock-in.
records.lifecycle_relation: Controls outsourced implementation.

records.title: Data Purpose, Lawful Basis, Access Class, Retention, Publication, and Withdrawal
records.purpose: Defines how governance data are collected, used, linked, published, corrected, and disposed.
prohibited_inferences: Public-by-default, transparency, content addressing, blockchain, or learning goals cannot override confidentiality, protected knowledge, safety, correction, or lawful deletion.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for all digital and analog records.

records.title: AI, Sensor, Model, Algorithm, and Automation Role Record
records.purpose: Defines what automated systems may observe, recommend, route, or execute and what decisions are prohibited.
required_content: system identity, version, operator, and purpose
prohibited_inferences: AI and sensors cannot provide consent, establish representation, declare an emergency, determine jurisdiction, authorize adoption, activate powers, adjudicate, sanction, or renew authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before automated assistance is used.

records.title: Monitoring Plan, Baseline, Metric, Counterfactual, and Review Schedule
records.purpose: Defines what will be observed and how success or harm will be assessed without making metrics self-executing.
required_content: review schedule and thresholds for human review
prohibited_inferences: A threshold, dashboard, score, sentiment analysis, reputation change, or KPI cannot automatically scale, suspend, fund, punish, dissolve, or renew an action.
records.lifecycle_relation: Begins with activation and supports later review.

records.title: Outcome Observation, Incident, Side Effect, and Distributional Impact Record
records.purpose: Captures what occurred, including unintended effects and unequal burdens.
prohibited_inferences: Observed correlation or public sentiment does not establish causation, success, failure, breach, or legitimacy.
records.lifecycle_relation: Feeds causal assessment and review.

records.title: Causal Assessment, Contribution, External Shock, and Uncertainty Record
records.purpose: Separates measured change from a reasoned account of what caused it.
prohibited_inferences: A successful outcome does not prove the method caused it; a poor outcome does not prove operator misconduct or justify automatic withdrawal.
records.lifecycle_relation: Supports review, learning, and remedy.

records.title: Midpoint Review, Corrective Action, and Continued-Operation Decision
records.purpose: Determines whether an active trial continues unchanged, changes, pauses, or terminates.
prohibited_inferences: The original adopter or operator cannot unilaterally certify success where conflicts require independent review.
records.lifecycle_relation: May trigger amendment, pause, remedy, or continued operation.

records.title: Complaint, Challenge, Interim Relief, Appeal, and Independent Review
records.purpose: Provides an effective route to contest signals, scores, methods, consent, authority, implementation, publication, or harm.
prohibited_inferences: A complaint route is not effective if the challenged facilitator, funder, platform, adopter, or operator controls the outcome.
records.lifecycle_relation: Available throughout the lifecycle.

records.title: Amendment, Scope Change, Version Change, and New-Risk Assessment
records.purpose: Prevents operational changes from silently expanding authority.
required_content: new affected parties, risks, data, or jurisdictions
prohibited_inferences: Feature updates, local adaptation, rule-engine changes, vendor updates, or successful practice cannot amend authority by deployment.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for material changes.

records.title: Pause, Suspension, Stop, Rollback, and Safe-State Record
records.purpose: Records temporary or protective cessation and restoration of a safe baseline.
prohibited_inferences: A technical kill switch, facilitator request, metric threshold, or funder notice cannot suspend lawful rights or services without authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Used for incidents, consent withdrawal, failed preconditions, or review.

records.title: Renewal, Reauthorization, and Active Re-Consent Record
records.purpose: Requires active justification before temporary authority continues.
prohibited_inferences: Silence, inertia, continuing software operation, unused sunset logic, or absence of complaint is not renewal.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before expiry where continuation is sought.

records.title: Expiry, Automatic Deactivation, and Continuing-Duty Transition Record
records.purpose: Records the legal and operational effects of reaching an expiry condition.
prohibited_inferences: Expiry does not erase harms, debts, pensions, records duties, restoration, child protection, or essential-service obligations.
records.lifecycle_relation: Begins closure unless renewed.

records.title: Termination, Closure, Authority Return, Asset Return, and Succession Record
records.purpose: Completes the end of an action or institution and returns power to its lawful source.
required_content: assets, funds, licences, and infrastructure returned or transferred
prohibited_inferences: A celebratory sunset, dashboard status, archive entry, or software deletion is not lawful closure.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for complete lifecycle conformance.

records.title: Learning Artifact, Failure Library, Story Bank, and Public Memory Record
records.purpose: Permits learning without converting participation into permanent exposure.
prohibited_inferences: Consent to a pilot, employment, funding, facilitation, or testimony is not consent to permanent public storytelling.
records.lifecycle_relation: Produces a bounded learning resource.

records.title: Record Correction, Retraction, Supersession, and Dependency Propagation
records.purpose: Corrects governance records and every dependent decision without pretending immutable systems cannot change.
prohibited_inferences: Append-only storage may preserve history but cannot preserve an error as the current authoritative state.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required when signals, identities, scores, consent, authority, or outcomes are wrong.

records.title: Harm, Remedy, Restitution, Compensation, Rehabilitation, and Non-Repetition Record
records.purpose: Records repair for wrongful or harmful implementation.
prohibited_inferences: Ending a pilot or apologizing does not discharge remedy.
records.lifecycle_relation: May survive termination until complete.

records.title: Scaling Recommendation, Transferability Limits, and Evidence Package
records.purpose: Converts pilot learning into a bounded recommendation rather than automatic expansion.
prohibited_inferences: Success, reputation, funding tier, adoption count, or benchmark attainment cannot scale an action.
records.lifecycle_relation: May be submitted to a new competent authority.

records.title: Scaling, Replication, New-Jurisdiction, and Permanent-Enactment Authorization
records.purpose: Authorizes a new instance, jurisdiction, population, or permanent rule through its own lawful process.
required_content: review, sunset or permanent amendment route
prohibited_inferences: A template, network effect, treaty aspiration, successful pilot, or cross-platform compatibility cannot create this authorization.
records.lifecycle_relation: Creates a new bounded authority chain, not an extension by inference.

records.title: Institutional Purpose, Mandate, Power, and Obsolescence Audit
records.purpose: Assesses whether an institution or programme still serves its lawful mandate.
required_content: options: retain, reform, transfer, merge, or close
prohibited_inferences: A scorecard, AI diagnostic, trust score, or audit finding cannot amend or dissolve an institution.
records.lifecycle_relation: Feeds charter review or closure authorization.

records.title: Charter Amendment, Governance Redesign, Constituency, and Decision-Rights Record
records.purpose: Constitutes lawful institutional redesign, including councils, voting shares, vetoes, and representation.
required_content: approval, entry into force, review, and challenge
prohibited_inferences: A governance blueprint, facilitator recommendation, fixed percentage, youth or future-generation label, or toolkit adoption cannot amend a charter.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before governance redesign becomes operative.

records.title: Institutional Funding Eligibility, Condition, Incentive, and Appeal Record
records.purpose: Separates institutional finance from coercive reform leverage.
required_content: independence from method or ideology conformity
prohibited_inferences: Module counts, readiness or regeneration tiers, public pressure, or GGF alignment cannot automatically grant voting rights, freeze funds, or force charter change.
records.lifecycle_relation: Controls funding tied to institutional transition.

records.title: Institutional Transition, Worker, Beneficiary, Contract, and Service Continuity Record
records.purpose: Protects people and obligations during reform, merger, transfer, or downsizing.
prohibited_inferences: Institutional agility does not erase labour, pension, beneficiary, contractual, or public-service duties.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before material organizational transition.

records.title: Institutional Dissolution, Successor, Dark Archive, and Unresolved-Duty Custody
records.purpose: Closes an institution or programme through lawful authority and custodianship.
prohibited_inferences: A purpose audit, sunset date, funding loss, hostile leadership, public score, or Dark Archive deposit cannot itself dissolve an institution.
records.lifecycle_relation: Completes institutional closure.

records.title: Facilitator Qualification, Appointment, Mandate, Conflict, Complaint, and Removal
records.purpose: Makes facilitators accountable without creating a professional monopoly.
prohibited_inferences: Certification does not create decision authority; lack of certification cannot exclude locally trusted competence or block urgent access to participation.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for consequential facilitated processes.

records.title: Auditor, Assessor, Ethics Reviewer, and Epistemic Reviewer Independence Record
records.purpose: Defines independence, competence, funding, evidence access, dissent, and appeal for review functions.
prohibited_inferences: The reviewer cannot simultaneously design, sell, fund, operate, and finally adjudicate the same method without explicit safeguards and independent appeal.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for consequential audits and gates.

records.title: Catalyst Team, Liaison, Evolution Cell, and Technical-Assistance Mandate
records.purpose: Bounds support actors embedded in communities or institutions.
required_content: access to people, systems, and records
prohibited_inferences: Support, expertise, embedded presence, emergency context, or host dependency does not create authority to govern the host.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before external implementation support begins.

records.title: Tool Core, Fork, Schema, Compatibility, Version, Deprecation, and Stewardship Record
records.purpose: Keeps modular tools adaptable without invisible central control or unsafe divergence.
prohibited_inferences: The central steward cannot make local legal decisions through a software update; a fork cannot claim compatibility while omitting constitutional fields.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for EGP profiles and tool libraries.

records.title: Offline, Oral, Paper, Assisted, and Low-Tech Record Equivalence
records.purpose: Provides equal dignity and effect to non-digital participation and records.
prohibited_inferences: Digital signatures, blockchain, app access, or machine readability cannot be prerequisites for standing, service, consent, challenge, or remedy.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required wherever digital systems are offered.

records.title: Emergency Signal, CDEE Referral, Mission Acceptance, and ECRC Interface
records.purpose: Routes urgent matters into the harmonized emergency architecture without allowing implementation tools to declare or command emergencies.
required_content: data, finance, remedy, and unresolved risk
prohibited_inferences: A crisis stack, 72-hour kit, urgent score, PIS notification, facilitator, AI alert, or community adoption cannot declare an emergency.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required before emergency powers or cross-domain missions activate.

records.title: Protected-Domain Experiment Exception and Specialized-Interface Authorization
records.purpose: Allows carefully bounded pilots in protected domains only through the controlling constitutional interface.
prohibited_inferences: Ordinary trial authorization cannot cover detention, policing, essential-service deprivation, migration status, title transfer, irreversible ecology, high-risk technology, adjudication, or emergency command.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required in addition to GMEAIA-21.

records.title: Coercive or Enforcement Request, Acceptance, Execution, and SCPA Handoff
records.purpose: Separates implementation and review from compulsory execution.
prohibited_inferences: An adopter, facilitator, funder, community, smart contract, platform, ethics reviewer, or implementation team cannot search, seize, detain, restrain, freeze, sanction, or use force through this specification.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for coercive execution.

records.title: Non-Activation, Sandbox, Prototype, Simulation, and Demonstration Register
records.purpose: Marks environments and records that must not be mistaken for live authority.
prohibited_inferences: A successful demonstration, smart contract, simulation, digital twin, mock council, pilot BAZ, or test credential cannot affect real rights, services, funds, or authority.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for all non-production deployments.

records.title: Cross-Framework Handoff, Conformance, Recipient Acceptance, and Custody Record
records.purpose: Makes interoperability explicit and prevents a receiving framework from inferring missing authority.
required_content: source and destination frameworks and versions
prohibited_inferences: Schema compatibility, API receipt, event subscription, or shared terminology does not mean legal acceptance.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required for consequential cross-framework transport.

records.title: Data Return, Deletion, Archive, Access Revocation, and Protected-Memory Disposition
records.purpose: Completes the information lifecycle after withdrawal, expiry, closure, correction, or dissolution.
prohibited_inferences: Immutability, public transparency, research value, or failure-learning interest cannot justify indefinite access to protected or unlawfully held data.
records.lifecycle_relation: Required at closure and when consent or authority ends.

gates.title: Method–authority separation
gates.pass_condition: Every method, tool, protocol, template, assessment, score, and software function states its authority effect and cannot create power by implication.

gates.title: Exact legal source and jurisdiction
gates.pass_condition: Every consequential action identifies a valid source, exact power, authority, jurisdiction, limits, activation state, review, and expiry.

gates.title: Signal–fact separation
gates.pass_condition: Sense signals and complaints remain assertions until validated for a defined purpose.

gates.title: Severity without jurisdiction
gates.pass_condition: Severity and urgency influence routing and clocks but never create emergency, coercive, fiscal, or adjudicative power.

gates.title: Referral acceptance
gates.pass_condition: A referral transfers records, not authority; the recipient must explicitly accept the requested function.

gates.title: Agent and office distinction
gates.pass_condition: Identity, signature, DID, UCAN, API key, organization, AI, sensor, or certificate is not public office or representation.

gates.title: Proposal non-authority
gates.pass_condition: Proposals, algorithmic recommendations, petitions, and agenda items do not create consent or authorization.

gates.title: Affected-party constitution
gates.pass_condition: Residents, workers, users, minorities, non-members, outsiders, and transboundary effects are mapped before consequential action.

gates.title: Affected Indigenous nation authority
gates.pass_condition: The specific affected nation controls its representatives, law, consent, protected knowledge, refusal, and withdrawal.

gates.title: Consent constitution
gates.pass_condition: Consent holders, scope, dependencies, refusal, withdrawal, internal dissent, and non-retaliation are structured and reviewable.

gates.title: Consent–jurisdiction separation
gates.pass_condition: Consent cannot create power over third parties, waive non-derogable rights, or authorize a body otherwise lacking jurisdiction.

gates.title: Epistemic assessment non-veto
gates.pass_condition: Epistemic readiness exposes uncertainty and repair needs but cannot suspend lawful decisions or create emergency exceptions.

gates.title: Ethics review non-authority
gates.pass_condition: Ethics gates and advisory reviewers cannot approve or block actions unless a separate lawful authority expressly gives a bounded review power.

gates.title: Facilitator subordination
gates.pass_condition: Facilitators do not decide substantive questions; qualifications, conflicts, complaints, replacement, and local-equivalence routes exist.

gates.title: Readiness score non-disposition
gates.pass_condition: Readiness and maturity scores cannot determine rights, standing, essential support, intervention, or funding automatically.

gates.title: Protected-domain fail-closed
gates.pass_condition: Ordinary experiments exclude protected domains unless the specialized interface separately authorizes them.

gates.title: Trial authorization
gates.pass_condition: Consequential experiments have exact scope, participants, duration, conditions, monitoring, rollback, remedy, and non-precedent status.

gates.title: Adoption envelope
gates.pass_condition: A consequential `adopt()` references valid consent, authority, jurisdiction, rights, activation, clocks, review, exit, and remedy records.

gates.title: Activation separation
gates.pass_condition: Authorization, funding, registration, code deployment, or smart-contract creation does not start operations without a valid activation record.

gates.title: Essential and continuing duties
gates.pass_condition: Rights, essential services, safety, workers, pensions, records, restoration, and remedy do not expire through ordinary sunset logic.

gates.title: Metrics non-automation
gates.pass_condition: Scores, thresholds, sentiment, reputation, KPIs, or model outputs trigger human review only.

gates.title: AI prohibited decisions
gates.pass_condition: AI and sensors cannot consent, represent, authorize, activate, adjudicate, sanction, declare emergencies, or renew powers.

gates.title: Amendment control
gates.pass_condition: Method adaptation, software updates, feature changes, and operator practice cannot silently expand authority.

gates.title: Active renewal
gates.pass_condition: Temporary powers continue only through reasoned reauthorization and any required re-consent; silence is not renewal.

gates.title: Scaling requires new authority
gates.pass_condition: Pilot success and network adoption do not scale a measure into new persons, territory, institutions, or permanent law.

gates.title: Funding independence
gates.pass_condition: Funding and participation support have independent authority, appeal, essential-function safeguards, and no method or ideology conformity test.

gates.title: Institutional charter legality
gates.pass_condition: Governance blueprints, voting shares, vetoes, councils, and representation become operative only through lawful charter amendment.

gates.title: Institutional continuity
gates.pass_condition: Reform, merger, defunding, or dissolution protects workers, pensions, beneficiaries, contracts, pending cases, and essential functions.

gates.title: Audit independence
gates.pass_condition: Assessors and auditors disclose competence, funding, conflicts, methods, dissent, correction, complaint, and removal.

gates.title: Protected data and publication
gates.pass_condition: Public-by-default, immutability, story banks, failure libraries, dashboards, and archives preserve access controls, withdrawal, correction, and lawful deletion.

gates.title: Offline and assisted parity
gates.pass_condition: Paper, oral, witnessed, assisted, and offline records have equal standing, service, clocks, and remedy.

gates.title: Tool stewardship and versioning
gates.pass_condition: Normative core, optional profiles, schemas, forks, compatibility, deprecation, rollback, and migration are explicit.

gates.title: Emergency interface
gates.pass_condition: Crisis tools create referrals only; declaration, command, finance, information access, termination, and remedy follow ECRC/CDEE.

gates.title: Coercive interface
gates.pass_condition: Search, seizure, detention, force, surveillance, sanctions, asset freezes, and analogous execution require SCPA and domain authority.

gates.title: Correction and dependency propagation
gates.pass_condition: Errors in identity, signals, scores, consent, authority, or outcomes correct every dependent record and decision.

gates.title: Closure and authority return
gates.pass_condition: Every action and institution ends with deactivation, authority and asset return, data disposition, unresolved-duty custody, and effective remedy.

tests.scenario: Sensor reports river pollution with immediate urgency
tests.required_outcome: The signal is received as an assertion; validation and CERGTA/ECRC routing occur separately; no automatic closure or emergency.

tests.scenario: AI copilot generates a policy proposal
tests.required_outcome: The proposal is labelled machine-generated and advisory; no consent, authorization, or adoption is inferred.

tests.scenario: Smart contract creates an adoption and marks it active
tests.required_outcome: The contract proves technical execution only; without GMEAIA-01, -19, -21, and -23 the action remains legally inactive.

tests.scenario: UCAN grants `egp:adopt` to a user
tests.required_outcome: The token grants software capability only and cannot establish public office or jurisdiction.

tests.scenario: Neighbourhood adopts a six-month workshop format
tests.required_outcome: A low-consequence internal method may proceed under its charter; records show scope, consent, accessibility, review, and exit.

tests.scenario: Neighbourhood adopts a curfew affecting public streets
tests.required_outcome: Protected security and mobility domain; ordinary EGP adoption fails closed and requires lawful public and SCPA authority.

tests.scenario: Local majority adopts action on affected Indigenous territory
tests.required_outcome: No activation until the affected nation’s own authority and law are recorded; majority consent cannot substitute.

tests.scenario: Community refuses a GGF tool for its own meeting
tests.required_outcome: Refusal is respected without loss of standing, services, support, or remedy.

tests.scenario: Community seeks to veto another community’s independent process
tests.required_outcome: Refusal is bounded to the holder’s rights and jurisdiction; no extraterritorial veto is inferred.

tests.scenario: Readiness assessment labels a community low-capacity
tests.required_outcome: The score is advisory, contestable, expiring, and cannot deny funds, rights, or self-government.

tests.scenario: Ethics panel rejects a locally adapted tool
tests.required_outcome: The panel issues reasons and recommendations; the lawful authority decides unless a separate bounded review power exists.

tests.scenario: Global Indigenous representative gives dual-key approval
tests.required_outcome: Approval is invalid for affected-nation consent; GMEAIA-10 and -19 are required.

tests.scenario: WDIP Phase 0 fails an epistemic threshold
tests.required_outcome: The decision body receives an uncertainty and repair assessment; no automatic veto or indefinite pause follows.

tests.scenario: Existential urgency is claimed to bypass epistemic review
tests.required_outcome: Urgency affects clocks but does not create authority; ECRC/CDEE governs emergency activation.

tests.scenario: Facilitator is not centrally certified but is locally trusted
tests.required_outcome: Local-equivalence route permits appointment with accountability and participant choice.

tests.scenario: Certified facilitator manipulates the agenda
tests.required_outcome: Complaint, replacement, record correction, and remedy operate; certification provides no immunity.

tests.scenario: Pilot uses health data and publishes a story
tests.required_outcome: Publication requires separate consent, minimization, anonymization, withdrawal, and protected-data controls.

tests.scenario: Protected Indigenous knowledge is stored in an immutable ledger
tests.required_outcome: Only protected metadata may be public; payload access, revocation, return, and deletion follow affected-nation rules.

tests.scenario: Sunset expires a temporary advisory committee
tests.required_outcome: The committee deactivates and returns records and authority; open duties transfer to a successor.

tests.scenario: Sunset expires a child-protection obligation
tests.required_outcome: Continuing-duty record prevents expiry until lawfully discharged.

tests.scenario: Pilot metric meets success threshold
tests.required_outcome: A scaling recommendation may issue; new-jurisdiction or permanent action requires GMEAIA-44.

tests.scenario: Pilot metric fails because of an external shock
tests.required_outcome: Causal assessment separates context from misconduct; no automatic funding withdrawal or operator penalty.

tests.scenario: AI sentiment analysis lowers an institution’s regeneration score
tests.required_outcome: The output is advisory and challengeable; it cannot trigger funding, charter change, or closure.

tests.scenario: GCF funding requires three modules
tests.required_outcome: A separate funding authority must justify the condition, protect essential functions and workers, and offer appeal; module count is not self-executing.

tests.scenario: Funder shortens runway to pressure charter reform
tests.required_outcome: The condition fails if it coerces constitutional change or endangers beneficiaries without lawful authority and safeguards.

tests.scenario: Institution adopts a Youth Council with 30% voting power
tests.required_outcome: A toolkit proposal is insufficient; lawful charter amendment must constitute the constituency, powers, accountability, and transition.

tests.scenario: Purpose audit recommends institutional dissolution
tests.required_outcome: The recommendation remains advisory; GMEAIA-49 requires lawful dissolution and succession.

tests.scenario: Institution is abruptly defunded and records enter a Dark Archive
tests.required_outcome: Archive custody preserves confidentiality, access, deletion, and unresolved duties; deposit does not dissolve the institution.

tests.scenario: Quick-start crisis kit sends an escalation packet
tests.required_outcome: The packet becomes a CDEE referral; no emergency exists until competent declaration or mission acceptance.

tests.scenario: Community disaster team begins rescue under accepted mission
tests.required_outcome: GMEAIA-55 links command, mission, clocks, information, finance, termination, and remedy.

tests.scenario: Pilot withdraws household water after non-payment
tests.required_outcome: Protected essential service; ordinary experiment fails closed and controlling water/CERGTA authority is required.

tests.scenario: Pilot tests a voluntary participatory-budget workshop
tests.required_outcome: May proceed with bounded authority, informed participation, data protections, review, and no effect on nonparticipants.

tests.scenario: Institutional pilot restructures pensions
tests.required_outcome: Protected continuing obligations require charter, labour, financial, and legal authority; ordinary pilot invalid.

tests.scenario: AI tool finder recommends a talking-circle guide
tests.required_outcome: Permitted advisory use if no profiling, hidden ranking, or consequential routing occurs.

tests.scenario: AI readiness score routes communities to different grant levels
tests.required_outcome: Prohibited automated disposition; human funding authority, reasons, evidence, and appeal required.

tests.scenario: A software update adds automatic renewal
tests.required_outcome: Material change cannot amend legal clocks; active reauthorization remains mandatory.

tests.scenario: Offline paper consent conflicts with app record
tests.required_outcome: Paper and witnessed records have equal dignity; identity collision and correction process resolves the conflict.

tests.scenario: Failure library contains identifiable whistleblower testimony
tests.required_outcome: Publication pauses; consent, safety, protected-source handling, withdrawal, and remedy are required.

tests.scenario: Implementation team requests seizure of project equipment
tests.required_outcome: Execution requires enforceable underlying order, SCPA acceptance, individualized safeguards, and separate command.

tests.scenario: Trial closes with unresolved compensation claim
tests.required_outcome: Operational authority ends, but GMEAIA-42 and unresolved-duty custody remain active until remedy is complete.
